paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: : Model complexity analysis.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between vocabulary size and scaled ratios of input complexity and embedding complexity. The x-axis represents the vocabulary size, with a linear scale ranging from 5000 to 40000 in intervals of 5000. The y-axis represents the scaled ratio, with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 in intervals of 0.2. The plot contains two lines: the blue line represents input complexity, marked with circular markers and a solid line style, which decreases from approximately 1.0 at a vocabulary size of 5000 to around 0.0 at a vocabulary size of 40000, with a notable decline between 15000 and 25000 vocabulary size; the green line represents embedding complexity, also marked with circular markers and a solid line style, which increases from around 0.0 at a vocabulary size of 5000 to approximately 1.0 at a vocabulary size of 40000, with a steady rise across the entire range of vocabulary sizes.
